title: HTTP and Javalin
description: Serving data over HTTP: how a request travels from browser to server, HTTP methods, status codes and JSON, routes and handlers in Javalin, and lambdas as handlers.
sourceCoverageNotes: Course slice: Foundation days F4-F18 (curriculum/snapshot/pep-curriculum.json /tracks/0/weeks/0/days/3 to /tracks/0/weeks/3/days/2). This module covers F15 (/tracks/0/weeks/2/days/4).
